description: Price-blind comfort MPC in shadow (track B2): plan production, solver health and plan shape, plus the comfort the house actually got under the legacy rule. KPIs of docs/components/climate-mpc.md.

panels.title: Job up
panels.description: 1 when the climate shadow job is loaded (configs, prior, site file).

panels.title: Last plan
panels.description: Time since the last decision run. Runs are hourly at HH:10 UTC.

panels.title: Regime
panels.description: Control regime recorded at the last run: legacy, comfort, comfort_off or unknown.

panels.title: Plan success (24 h)
panels.description: planned / all runs in the last 24 h. Anything but planned is no_state (no valid observer state, for example heating off), no_inputs, plan_failed or error.

panels.title: Last plan top-offset share
panels.description: Share of the last plan's heating slots at the top water offset (+6 K). The replay saw 13 to 22% of planned slots at the top, where the COP table is extrapolated.

panels.title: Scoring queue
panels.description: Decisions waiting for the local day of their last horizon slot to complete.

panels.title: Shadow plan: what the optimizer would do (advisory, it never acts on the heat pump)
Heating planned now
panels.description: climate_plan_heating_planned_now: the plan's current slot permits space heating. Absent (no data) when the mode is off or no plan is current; absent is not off.

panels.title: Water target now
panels.description: climate_plan_water_target_celsius: absolute water target of the current slot, only while heating is planned.

panels.title: Plan state
panels.description: climate_plan_state: planned, skipped, error, mode_off, no_plan or expired (what /climate/plan serves).

panels.title: Plan age
panels.description: Time since the latest plan was generated. Plans are hourly at HH:10 UTC and valid for 90 minutes.

panels.title: Plan valid
panels.description: climate_plan_valid: the latest plan is inside its valid_until. Alert: 0 for 2 h.

panels.title: Mode requested
panels.description: The owner's choice, input_select.climate_optimizer_mode (else the optimizer's config).

panels.title: Mode effective
panels.description: What the optimizer does; never live in this version.

panels.title: Live locked
panels.description: climate_plan_live_locked: live requested and refused (ADR-0008 proposed, not accepted). Expected 0 unless the owner selected live.

panels.title: Planned heating against heat pump power
panels.description: Bars: the plan permits heating in the slot (right axis, 0/1, advisory: the heat pump follows its thermostats and the rule). Line: sensor.aquarea_heat_power_consumed (W, space heating). Not a control loop; the plan is not executed.

panels.title: Planned water target against the heat pump outlet
panels.description: Plan: the absolute water target of the heating slots (null while off). Actual: sensor.aquarea_outlet_temperature and sensor.aquarea_outlet_target_temperature (degC). The legacy rule sets the real target.

panels.title: Runs by result (per hour)
panels.description: increase(climate_shadow_runs_total{result}[1h]). planned is the goal; no_state is expected while space heating is off (the observer has no valid state).

panels.title: Plan success (rolling 24 h)
panels.description: planned runs / all runs, rolling 24 h.

panels.title: Plans per day by result (rolling 24 h)
panels.description: Runs in the last 24 h by result. 24 per day is a plan every hour.

panels.title: Solves by status (per 6 h)
panels.description: Comfort-MPC MILP solves by status: optimal, gap (stopped at the MIP gap), time_limit, infeasible, error.

panels.title: Solves not optimal (rolling 24 h)
panels.description: (gap + time_limit + infeasible + error) / all solves, rolling 24 h. infeasible and error should be zero.

panels.title: Solve duration
panels.description: One MILP solve; the solver time limit is 20 s (climate-mpc.yaml). Quantiles over 6 h.

panels.title: Top-offset share
panels.description: Share of planned heating slots at the top water offset: last plan, and over the scored window (legacy and new). A high share means plans lean on water temperatures the COP table does not cover.

panels.title: Scoring queue and scored origins
panels.description: Queue: decisions waiting to be scored. Scored: forecast origins that left the queue by result.

panels.title: Reference: comfort the rule delivered in the MPC's rooms (the plan's deficit is compared with this)
Degree-hours below the 21 degC floor per room (Kh, rolling 24 h)
panels.description: sum(max(21 - T, 0)) over 5 min steps / 12, rooms bedroom, hall_kitchen, office_t (comfort.rooms of climate.yaml; floor_c 21 of climate-mpc.yaml). Measured on the house under the legacy rule, not a planned figure: the MPC's planned deficit is a record in the private store, not a metric.

panels.title: Hall-kitchen against the 23.5 degC day minimum (degC)
panels.description: Hall-kitchen temperature (thermostat reading) and the day minimum of the comfort schedule (day_min_c 23.5 in climate-mpc.yaml, weekdays from 12:00 local, weekends from 09:00).

options.content: **Not yet measured** (no metric exists today; see the component page, section KPIs): planned comfort deficit (Kh below the band, per plan), planned against actual heat-pump energy, plan-over-rule electricity ratio, shadow cost against actual. They live in the private store (`climate_decisions`, `climate_scores`); offline: `battery-optimizer climate-shadow-report`. The solver and plan-shape panels above are the live part.
